text:
Aisha (CSM): Heads up — Lighthouse just signaled a cross-org expansion. They're adding two squads (Legal Ops + Analytics) and expect ~3-4x QPS in ~6 weeks. Putting this on our radar for capacity, enablement, and renewal upsell.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Good call. Can we get planned qps, avg session length, token estimates, and whether they need EU residency? Also thinking Dedicated pilot + canary. @Sam can you advise on runtime implications?
Marta (Lighthouse): Quick context from our side: two new squads starting PoC next month. Typical session ~1200 tokens, peak concurrency ~45, initial estimate ~5M tokens/day (could double). Must keep EU data for legal reasons and need KMS integration for keying.
Aisha (CSM): Renewal is in ~10 weeks; big upside if we support this ramp. Need coordinated enablement, security checklist, and a clear canary plan so they feel safe.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Proposal: 2-week Dedicated pilot in eu-west-1 with 10% canary traffic -> then scale to full. Suggest autoscale: min 2 pods, max 10, burst policy disabled. I'll draft a config and cost ballpark.
Sam (Eng): We can allocate a canary on the eu-west GPU pool. Notes: 1200-token average means batching will matter. If they use a quantized model (q8) we can hit p95 ~220-300ms on A100 depending on batch size. KV prefix caching would reduce token spend significantly.
Noah (Support): Opening a quota/bump ticket for them now and adding incident playbook placeholder. Who's owning billing/upsell? cc @Jules.
Jules (Account Exec): I'll own renewal/upsell. Diego, can you share a rough cost delta vs hosted so I can prep the commercial proposal?
Diego (Solutions Eng): Ballpark: Dedicated pilot gives predictable throughput; short-term cost +~40% vs hosted variable, but at scale per-token cost drops ~20%. I'll post a short spreadsheet with assumptions: https://redwood.internal/docs/lighthouse-cost-estimate (draft).
Marta (Lighthouse): We also need SOC2/KMS and EU data residency confirmation. Can we sign a data processing addendum?
Aisha (CSM): Looping Eng Security & Legal to confirm. Marta — I'll route their checklist and ask Eng Security for required artifacts.
deploy-bot: Canary slot created: dedicated-pilot/lighthouse-1745056789 — scheduled 2025-06-01T08:00Z
Diego (Solutions Eng): Scheduling enablement: propose Wed 2025-05-21 16:00 UTC for runbook + integration walkthrough. Who from Lighthouse will attend?
Marta (Lighthouse): I'll bring the engineering lead + product manager. Also want a short SLI/SLO discussion for their critical endpoints.
Aisha (CSM): 👍 I'll update the onboarding playbook and handoff doc. Next steps summary: Diego -> config by EOD Fri; Sam -> confirm GPU slot and caching defaults; Noah -> open quota + incident playbook; Jules -> draft renewal upsell tiers.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Sharing initial config snippet for pilot:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 10
  target_qps_per_replica: 20
routing:
  region: eu-west-1
  fallback_model: gpt-open-lite-ql8
```
Sam (Eng): Note for the team: enable KV prefix caching for convo-heavy flows — expect 3-5x token savings for their pattern. Also recommend session affinity so cold-start KV misses are minimized.
Marta (Lighthouse): Appreciate it. One more ask: can you confirm SLA during ramp? We need 99.9% for some endpoints.
Jules (Account Exec): We'll propose Bronze/Silver SLA tiers in the renewal package. Aisha — can you capture which endpoints they'll classify as critical?
Aisha (CSM): On it. Adding action items to the Playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/lighthouse-onboard (private).
Diego (Solutions Eng): I'll attach the config + cost sheet to the playbook by Friday. If Eng Security needs additional controls, flag them and we'll include in pilot checklist.
Eng Security (team): We'll review the checklist once Aisha routes the request. Expect follow-up questions on KMS key types and audit log retention.
Legal (team): We can route a DPA draft; need the full data flow diagram from Lighthouse. Marta, can you share that during the enablement?
Marta (Lighthouse): Yes — will prepare DFD + expected endpoints for Wed session. Thanks everyone.
Aisha (CSM): Great progress. I'll run the enablement invite and update the renewal watch. Closing for now — ping here with any blockers.
